_sourceConvention: _source values prefixed `oca-` are OCA-jurisdiction (not flagged as gaps by the print report). Anything else is flagged unless listed in trackedGaps below.

parishOverrides.reason: Parish uses standard Sunday Entrance Hymn ('Come, let us worship...') year-round; OCA Liturgikon prints Paschal entrance ('In the gatherings...') during the Paschal period. Documented in commit 0b5d18c.

trackedGaps.scope: Eothinon Exapostilarion + Theotokion + Lauds doxastikon (11 eothinon sets)
trackedGaps.researchPointer: OCA Pentecostarion volume contains the eothinon set. No predictable OCA URL identified at oca.org. Investigate: OCA-published Pentecostarion (St. Tikhon's Seminary Press), oca.org service-music for eothinon-specific PDFs.

knownFailures.reason: Pascha is served via /api/paschal-matins (a fully distinct service); the regular /api/matins endpoint is intentionally unused. Audit rule shouldn't flag Sunday Matins skeleton against a date that doesn't use Sunday Matins. addedAt 2026-06-05.

Feast/saint Matins Gospel overrides the eothinon when a major feast or vigil-rank saint with their own gospel falls on Sunday — OCA rubrical practice. 01-11 Sunday after Theophany, 01-25 Sunday of Zacchaeus, 07-05 St Sergius/Athanasius, 08-16 Translation of Image Not Made by Hands, 11-08 Synaxis of the Archangels, 12-06 St Nicholas. addedAt 2026-06-05.

2026-05-10: false positive — Myrrhbearers Beatitude 'beareth witness to you, O violators' is grammatical plural-you-object, not YY drift. addedAt 2026-06-18 (06-14 cleared 2026-06-19 by yy→tt pass on synaxis-na-saints.json).

Lenten/Triodion Saturday Sat-eve Great Vespers LIC Theotokion-after-Glory gap. Documented edge case per features/vespers-assembly.md INV-3 follow-up: 'LIC Theotokion tone is week-tone, not Glory-tone… Slavic strict rubric is to draw the LIC Theotokion from the Menaion appendix in the tone of the Glory; we have only the week-tone Octoechos version.' Saturdays where the Menaion Glory doxastichon doesn't have a paired Theotokion in the available data. Fix path: index Menaion appendix theotokia. addedAt 2026-06-18.

Remaining Sat-eve Great Vespers Aposticha Theotokion tone mismatches after the for-date.js Saturday-branch re-key (2026-06-19). These four have a different root cause than the original 28-entry data gap: (1) 01-31/02-07/02-21 are Triodion Sundays (Publican/Pharisee, Prodigal Son, Forgiveness) where calendar-rules ships a Triodion-source apost.glory + apost.now in matching tones, but for-date.js menaion-injection still overrides apost.glory with the menaion saint's order=0 — the Triodion should win on Triodion Sundays; (2) 06-13 is NA Saints Sunday whose menaion order=-1 Theotokion is authored in tone 5 even though the saint's Glory is in tone 4 (saint's own Theotokion, not an Octoechos-appendix lookup; rule may be too strict for this pairing). Fix paths: (a) don't override apost.glory when calendar entry already has source:'triodion'/'pentecostarion'; (b) revisit D4's rule when Theotokion source is menaion order=-1. addedAt 2026-06-19.

Vigil-rank / paschal-cycle Sat-eve Vespers Aposticha: Glory present but Now+Theotokion missing. Three Hierarchs Vigil (01-29), Lazarus Sat (03-27), pentecostarion Saturdays (04-25, 05-02, 05-09, 05-16), late-June Sat eves (06-23, 06-28). Same data gap class as D2/D4 — Aposticha Theotokion not injected when the Glory comes from a Menaion/Pentecostarion path. addedAt 2026-06-18.

Annunciation Matins Aposticha is a Great Feast (Lord's feast) whose Aposticha structure renders a combined Glory+Now + single feast sticheron (no weekday-shape stichera blend). Real edge case, not a regression. addedAt 2026-06-18.

Same root cause as M3 known-failures: festal-Sunday Matins Gospel + Prokeimenon override the Octoechos cycle when a major feast or vigil-rank saint with their own Gospel falls on Sunday. Sun after Theophany (01-11), Sun of Zacchaeus (01-25), Translation of Image (08-16), Synaxis of Archangels (11-08), St Nicholas (12-06). addedAt 2026-06-18.
